mechanism: Turn craft into a visible proof ladder: establish one raw material, perform several functionally different manipulations that progressively change its length, topology or organization, cross one irreversible processing threshold, assemble the result, and end on a macro finished-state proof that visibly inherits features created earlier.

invariants.rule: Establish one raw material and its maker before complex manipulation.
invariants.purpose: Gives viewers a stable before state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening on spectacle removes the transformation baseline.

invariants.rule: Use at least three functionally different manipulations that visibly change the same material.
invariants.purpose: Makes skill cumulative rather than repetitive.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated tossing without distinct material effects is only flourish.

invariants.rule: Keep the material identity and work-surface geography continuous across the manipulation ladder.
invariants.purpose: Lets viewers connect each phase causally.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unmotivated material substitutions break the proof.

invariants.rule: Cross one visible irreversible processing threshold before the result assembly.
invariants.ablation_failure: A finished object appearing without a threshold feels swapped in.

invariants.rule: End on a macro finished-state proof that retains visible evidence of earlier transformations.
invariants.purpose: Closes the causal ladder with a verifiable result.
invariants.ablation_failure: A wide beauty shot alone hides whether the material work mattered.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source noodle dough and shrimp bowl
source noodle-loop choreography and food macro finish

instantiations.concept: A solar-sail conservator starts with one bundle of translucent plant fiber, draws it into ribbon, splits and braids a lattice, tensions it over a frame, heat-seals it once, then ends on a macro proof of the finished light-filter membrane.
